title: Arabic: Alphabet and Forms
description: For beginners learning the 28 Arabic letters in four positions. Includes names, transliteration, formal sounds, and joining limits. Connector strokes illustrate forms; examples show words containing each letter.

sources.name: Original educational explanations from general subject knowledge
